## 中文原文
你周末在家整理书桌。翻出很多旧笔记和旧照片。翻看的时候回忆起以前上学的日子。不知不觉过去了一个多小时，书桌还没有完全收拾完。

## My translation
I tidied my desk up on the weekend. I got many old notes and pictures.
Looking at them made me thinking of those schooling days.
Time flied away and one hour passed, I still did not finish the cleaning of desk.

## Revised version
I tidied up my desk over the weekend.
I came across lots of old notes and photos.
Looking at them made me think of school days.
Time flew by, and one hour went by before I knew it.
I still hadn't finished cleaning my desk.

## Key phrases
- tidied up my desk
- came across, 偶然翻到
- time flew by, 时光飞逝
- before I knew it, 不知不觉间
